name: Fraud
overview: The Bible clearly condemns fraud as a violation of God's standards for honesty and righteousness. Leviticus 19:11 forbids stealing and deceitful dealings, emphasizing truthful interactions among people. Proverbs 11:1 highlights that dishonest measures are an abomination to the Lord, contrasting them with His delight in fairness. Additionally, the Psalms remind us that God knows the secrets of the heart (Psalms 44:21) and that the wicked who fail to repay debts act unjustly (Psalms 37:21). True wealth and security come not from dishonest gain but from diligent labor and righteousness (Proverbs 10:2; 13:11).
